messages:
kevin: heads-up team — prepping cross-service cutover (router -> api -> runtime -> console) in 25m UTC. window ~30-60m. plan: staged canaries, manual rollback. please ack and be on standby :wave:
olga: ack. i'll own router header-split and traffic steer. will only flip header when console confirms `x-rw-split` acceptance.
rahul: i'll run runtime canary. variant `v3-quant-small` pinned for canary hosts. watching kv cache and kernel config.
maria: publishing release notes now: https://go/release/1776. note: console split is opt-in; router will fallback to legacy header if console not ready.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-22T17:00:00Z. Sequence: router(canary 5%) -> runtime(canary) -> api(canary) -> console -> ramp. Runbook: /runbooks/cutover-1776.
ops-bot: baseline snapshots captured: perf/1776002469. alerts to #incidents.
kevin: rollback thresholds proposed: api p95 > 600ms OR errors > 1% over 5m => abort. runtime p99 > 800ms OR 5xx > 1% => abort. immediate abort on sustained 5xx spike. manual rollback only.
rahul: adding KV-miss abort: if kv miss rate > 10% for 2m straight, abort runtime canary.
olga: console smoke queued. if parsing warnings > 1% i'll block header flip and report.
deploy-bot: Canary started — router at 5%. runtime pinned on 4 canary hosts.
olga: router canary healthy. no 5xx, latency flat. starting runtime canary to 25%.
rahul: runtime p99 ~420ms, errors 0.1%. bumping to 25%. watching gc and kv misses.
maria: api canary go for 10m at 25% after runtime stabilizes. release note reminder: clients may see transient 429s during final ramp.
ops-bot: synthetics: all green. no alerts firing.
kevin: reminder: console gate is opt-in. only flip `x-rw-split` header when lauded by console team.
olga: console smoke: header accepted, low warning counts. ready for api rollout.
deploy-bot: proceeding with api canary 25% -> monitor for 10m. auto-rollback disabled.
rahul: small kv miss jitter to 6% now, under threshold.
maria: api p95 190ms, errors 0.12%. continue ramp.
kevin: decision: if any service hits abort criteria during api -> halt and rollback runtime+api to previous stable. ops keep rollback command handy: `deploy-bot rollback --to v2.9.8`.
olga: router final ramp in progress. flipping header on 50% slice now.
ops-bot: short console warning spike 0.9% for 90s. below abort but flagging.
kevin: hold final 100% ramp for 5m until warnings clear.
rahul: runtime stable at 50%, p99 430ms. no kv spikes.
maria: publishing short post-cutover note in release doc and tracking follow-ups.
deploy-bot: Cutover complete at 17:46 UTC. All services on new variants. Please file follow-ups in #eng-releases if you spot anything. :tada:
